# Tour Voucher Confirmation Checklist

Internal WMIT checklist. A voucher must not be issued as `CONFIRMED` until all required checks pass or an authorized exception is recorded.

## Document control

- [ ] Legal company name confirmed
- [ ] Voucher number generated
- [ ] Package version recorded
- [ ] Master Terms version recorded
- [ ] Issue date/time and timezone recorded
- [ ] Status selected: Draft / For Confirmation / Confirmed / Amended

## Traveler and price

- [ ] Lead passenger selected
- [ ] Adults, children, and infants recorded
- [ ] Child ages recorded when required by tariff or supplier
- [ ] Exact departure and return dates confirmed
- [ ] Duration and nights reconcile
- [ ] Occupancy and room basis confirmed
- [ ] Client price and currency shown
- [ ] Deposit and payment schedule shown
- [ ] Final-payment date is exact and not contradictory

## Itinerary quality

- [ ] Every day has a date, route, meals, activities, and overnight city
- [ ] Meal codes are defined
- [ ] Included, optional, exterior-only, photostop, and subject-to-availability items are labelled
- [ ] No duplicated itinerary text remains
- [ ] Every city transition is logically consistent
- [ ] Hotel-night total equals stated nights
- [ ] Transport segments have confirmed/pending status
- [ ] Flight/train numbers, times, baggage, and references are recorded where available
- [ ] No unresolved alternative hotel appears in a confirmed voucher
- [ ] Guide, escort, coach, entrance, and activity status is recorded

## Commercial and cancellation

- [ ] Inclusions and exclusions are complete
- [ ] Taxes, visa fees, city taxes, tips, baggage, and insurance treatment is clear
- [ ] Cancellation table is attached
- [ ] Minimum participant rule is stated
- [ ] Price-validity and price-change rule is stated
- [ ] Client acceptance is recorded
- [ ] Accepted terms and voucher versions are preserved

## Final approval

- [ ] Operations review complete
- [ ] Finance/payment review complete
- [ ] Supplier confirmations attached or status-labelled
- [ ] Legal review complete for new or materially changed Terms
- [ ] Authorized staff approved issuance
